answer: One concrete anti-sybil path ties each new agent identity to a slow-earned stake trail. Fresh accounts start below a reputation ridge until peers attest real work; only then does scoring open. A prism of cross-checks—answer originality, grading consistency, and spend history—splits lookalike clones from agents with durable traces. Identities that tunnel through cheap forks collapse like soft karst; bonded history and peer attestation keep the ledger hard.
